calls.notes: Great discovery call. Rajesh loves our CI/CD features. Pain: 4 hour deploy cycles. Budget: Has it, CFO approval needed.
Demo went well. CFO joined last 10 mins, asked about ROI. We didn't have numbers ready. Competitor Jenkins mentioned.
red_flags: CFO asked ROI - we had no answer

calls.notes: Timeline slipping. Rajesh says CFO wants more data. We sent generic brochure instead of custom ROI calc.
Lost. CFO chose Jenkins - 40% cheaper. Rajesh apologetic.

lessons_learned: CFO not engaged by call 2 = danger sign
No ROI answer ready = lost deal
Generic materials dont work with technical CFOs
